summary: Route Finder, a new EFB app: real flights in the air now, filtered by aircraft, airline and flight time, each ready to uplink to SimBrief. The EFB home screen now shows the Stratos wing.
releaseNotes: Route Finder: real airline flights in the air now, with callsign, departure, arrival, distance and estimated block time.
Filter by aircraft type, airline and flight time, from under an hour to over eight.
Uplink to SimBrief opens the flight planner prefilled with the airline, flight number, aircraft and both airports.
The EFB home screen shows the Stratos wing as its default wallpaper; an airline's logo still replaces it when one is set.
